name: Tomonari no Fune
source:
Mikura Tagane is an unsuccessful sex worker who lives alone. When she went out onto her veranda after work, she accidentally spotted a man and a woman having sex in the apartment opposite hers. Her eyes met with the man's and wanting to avoid trouble, Tagane goes back inside and closes her curtains. Moments later, her doorbell rings. Though having a bad feeling, she answers the door and it was that man she spotted. He then forcefully enters her apartment and rapes her. On top of that, the man goes through her fridge and sleeps in her bed- essentially, doing whatever he wants. 

Fearing that her parents would contact her, Tagane doesn't report him to the police. Given that she was also tired from work, she falls right asleep. 

That day marked the beginning of Tagane and that man's strange relationship...
translation:
美仓たがね独自生活，是一名生意冷清的性工作者。某天工作结束后，她走到阳台上，意外看见对面公寓里的一男一女正在做爱。她与男人四目相对，为了避免惹上麻烦，便退回屋内，拉上了窗帘。没过多久，门铃响了。虽然心中涌起不祥的预感，她还是开了门，门外正是刚才看见的那个男人。他强行闯入她的公寓，将她强暴。随后，他又翻找冰箱里的东西，睡上她的床，简直为所欲为。

たがね害怕父母会因此联系自己，不敢报警。加上工作的疲惫，她就这样沉沉睡去。

从那天起，たがね与那个男人之间，一段奇妙的关系开始了…
